Necrobinder — Act 3 boss 2-card combo effectiveness

n (with) = observations (one per Act 3 boss fight -- one below ascension 10, two at ascension 10+, fought independently) where the run owned BOTH cards by the time of the fight; "without" is everyone else (owns just one, or neither) -- not a true synergy test, see the homepage methodology. Diff (HP saved) = avg without minus avg with; positive means the pair correlates with less damage. Use the boss selector to switch between a single boss and the 4-boss combined ranking (both server-computed, not re-aggregated in the browser). Only pairs with min(n_with, n_without) > 100 are included at all (main columns pool every ascension; Δ (A9/A10 only) re-runs the same comparison restricted to ascension 9-10 at the same threshold -- dash = that pair didn't clear the threshold on the A9/A10 subset alone). Each pair is only scored using runs on a patch at or after the more recent of its two cards' last balance changes (see Last changed patch).

Full methodology and caveats: see the 2-card combo effectiveness methodology on the homepage.
